item.title: Combiner 0.10.0
item.description:
• New here? The first launch asks the name you show up as and whether your project is shared. Nothing from your projects leaves the Mac until you choose.
  • Prepare this project: before a big project's first render (more than 40 tracks, or a heavy one), Combiner asks first, says how many tracks and roughly how many gigabytes each person would get, and renders in batches, quickest first.
  • Lighter renders: prints are ORIGINAL + WET by default (DRY and slices are optional in ⚙︎ › Track prints), muted and off tracks aren't rendered in Logic or Live, and prints stop at their last sound.
  • Each track's newest version downloads by itself; older versions download when you click them (⚙︎ › Download › Everything brings them all).
  • Older received renders you never dragged out go to the Trash 14 days after a newer one arrives. Anything you dragged into a DAW, pinned, or that a saved project uses is never touched. ⚙︎ › Old renders › Received › Keep all turns it off.
  • When your internet can't keep up with the renders, Auto renders less often until the room has caught up, and ⚙︎ says so.
  • Ableton Live: about twice as fast per render (one launch instead of two), pauses while you play, and handles Session View scenes, VST2 plug-in names, hidden or minimized Live, and exports matched to the right tracks. Tested on sets built and saved by Live itself.
  • Renaming a Logic track keeps its plug-ins, patches and file names, and copies you already have pick up the new name.
  • Background renders leave Logic's Open Recent list as you had it, and a project you close in Logic reads as closed.
  • The room bar has New and Leave next to the room code; recent rooms fold and scroll.
  • ⚙︎ › Internet relay shows how much the room's relay has carried this month.
  • An anonymous daily usage summary is now sent (no names, files, projects or audio). Turn it off in ⚙︎ › Usage data.
